bootPadWizard.bootPadsRequiredDesc: Your board ({{boardName}}) uses a USB-serial adapter and cannot enter bootloader mode via software. You'll need to physically short the boot pads.
bootPadWizard.disconnectDesc: Unplug the USB cable from your flight controller
bootPadWizard.doNotDisconnect: Do not disconnect the board during flashing!
bootPadWizard.guideIntro: This wizard will guide you through:
bootPadWizard.jumperRemovedConfirm: I have removed the boot jumper (USB still connected)
bootPadWizard.removeJumperDesc: Keep the USB connected, but remove the jumper wire now. This way, after flashing completes, the board will boot into the new firmware instead of staying in bootloader.
bootPadWizard.removeJumperTitle: Before flashing: Remove the boot jumper!
bootPadWizard.riskConfirm: I understand that flashing incorrect firmware can brick my board and I have verified the board selection is correct
bootPadWizard.scanning: Scanning serial ports for STM32 bootloader...
bootPadWizard.shortConfirm: I have shorted the boot pads and reconnected the USB cable
bootPadWizard.shortStep1: Find the BOOT pads on your board (usually labeled "BOOT" or "BT" near the MCU)
bootPadWizard.shortStep2: Use tweezers, a jumper wire, or conductive material to short the two pads together
bootPadWizard.shortStep3: Keep them shorted and plug in the USB cable
bootPadWizard.successDesc: Your board should now reboot with the new firmware. You can reconnect and configure it.
bootPadWizard.title: Boot Pad Flash Wizard
bootPadWizard.waitingDesc: Make sure the boot pads are shorted and USB is connected

firmwareFlashView.autoDetectedFromConnection: Board info auto-detected from active connection
firmwareFlashView.bootloaderModeDesc: Your board is ready for flashing. Complete this checklist before proceeding:
firmwareFlashView.checkBoardSelected: I have selected the correct board from the dropdown
firmwareFlashView.checkBoardSelectedHint: In bootloader mode we can only detect the chip (e.g., STM32F303), not the board model
firmwareFlashView.checkJumperRemoved: I have removed the boot jumper / released the boot pads
firmwareFlashView.checkJumperRemovedHint: The board will reboot after flashing. Remove the jumper so it boots into new firmware.
firmwareFlashView.connectViaUsb: Connect your flight controller via USB
firmwareFlashView.connectedWarning: Flashing requires disconnecting from the board first. The board will reboot into bootloader mode for flashing.
firmwareFlashView.detectedNoBoards: Detected {{mcu}} but no known boards in database. Please select manually.
firmwareFlashView.manualBootloaderEntry: This board needs manual bootloader entry
firmwareFlashView.noExactInavTarget: No exact iNav target found for "{{board}}"
firmwareFlashView.noStableReleases: No stable releases available for this board. Enable Beta or Dev in Advanced mode to see pre-release versions.
firmwareFlashView.noVersionsMatch: No versions match current filters for {{group}}. Enable Beta or Dev to see more.
firmwareFlashView.pinMismatchWarning: If you select a different board target, the pin assignments may not match your hardware. Motors, servos, and sensors could be on different pins. Check the iNav wiki for your specific board before flashing.
firmwareFlashView.probeHint: Probe will attempt to detect STM32 chip via bootloader
firmwareFlashView.recoveryNote: Recovery is always possible! If the new firmware doesn't work, put the board back in bootloader mode (boot pads/button) and flash again. You can always return to any firmware.
firmwareFlashView.recoveryShort: Recovery: If issues occur, put the board in bootloader mode and flash again.
firmwareFlashView.sameNameIdentical: If your exact board is available with the same name, the pinout will be identical.
firmwareFlashView.settingsResetWarning: Settings will be reset! Switching firmware (e.g., Betaflight → iNav) erases all configuration. You'll need to set up PIDs, modes, and receivers again. Save your current settings first if needed.
firmwareFlashView.stillConnected: The board is still connected on the left. Disconnect it (banner above) to enable flashing.
firmwareFlashView.unplugReconnect: Unplug and reconnect your board to start using the new firmware.
firmwareFlashView.usbSerialChip: Your {{board}} uses a USB-serial chip and can't enter bootloader via software. Don't worry - the wizard will guide you through it!

radioSdView.afterInstallNote: After installing: eject the SD volume, unplug USB, then on the radio add the widget to a model screen (long-press TELE, full-screen widget). Packages are downloaded from their official repositories at install time.
radioSdView.bwInstallNote: Monochrome radios have no widgets, so install also points every model's telemetry screen at the script. Nothing to set up on the radio: eject, unplug, press PAGE from the main view.
radioSdView.configureInHud: Configure and preview this widget in the <link>Radio HUD</link> view.
radioSdView.ejectPressPage: Eject, unplug, then press PAGE from the main view.
radioSdView.installTip: Fetch the package and copy it to the SD card
radioSdView.noCardStep1: Power on the radio and connect it via USB
radioSdView.noCardStep2: Choose USB Storage (SD) on the radio screen
radioSdView.noFreeScreen: No free telemetry screen on {{models}}: free one of the four screens there and install again.
radioSdView.notAvailableForScreen: Not available for the selected radio screen
radioSdView.readBwGuide: Read the guide for monochrome radios
radioSdView.reinstallTip: Reinstall or update to the latest release
radioSdView.removeTip: Remove all files this package installed
radioSdView.screensSetUp_one: Set up on the radio: telemetry screen pointed at the HUD on {{count}} model.
radioSdView.screensSetUp_other: Set up on the radio: telemetry screen pointed at the HUD on {{count}} models.
radioSdView.sdVersionMismatch: SD card contents are from EdgeTX {{sdVersion}} but the radio runs {{fwVersion}}. Update the card from the EdgeTX sdcard release before relying on sounds or themes.
radioSdView.title: Radio SD Card
